description: This file defines a helper class for manipulating a PyTorch FX graph, including managing dependencies, node merging, cycle detection, and path checking for graph transformations.

classes.name: AugmentedGraphHelper
classes.description: A helper class to augment and analyze FX graph nodes with additional dependencies, merge sets, cycle detection, and path analysis.

methods.name: __init__( self, graph: fx.Graph, node_ancestors: Optional[dict[fx.Node, OrderedSet[fx.Node]]] = None, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with a FX graph, optional node ancestors, and setting up internal data structures.

methods.name: None add_extra_dep(self, *, n: fx.Node, dep: fx.Node)
methods.description: Add an extra dependency from a node to another node.

methods.name: None remove_extra_dep(self, *, n: fx.Node, dep: fx.Node)
methods.description: Remove an existing extra dependency between two nodes.

methods.name: None merge_to_set(self, existing_node: fx.Node, new_node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Merge a new node into an existing node's merge set.

methods.name: None unmerge_node(self, node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Remove a node from its merge set, making it a singleton.

methods.name: OrderedSet[fx.Node] get_merged_deps(self, node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Retrieve all dependencies for a node, considering merges and extra deps.

methods.name: bool has_cycle(self)
methods.description: Check if the graph contains a cycle considering merged dependencies.

methods.name: bool has_path(self, source: fx.Node, target: fx.Node)
methods.description: Determine if there is a path from source to target node.

methods.name: None transfer_erased_node_deps( self, erased_to_new: dict[fx.Node, fx.Node | None] )
methods.description: Transfer dependencies from erased nodes to their replacements, updating dependencies accordingly.

methods.name: dict[fx.Node,OrderedSet[fx.Node]] get_all_extra_deps(self)
methods.description: Get all extra dependencies in a format suitable for topological sorting.

ctags.signature: ( self, graph: fx.Graph, node_ancestors: Optional[dict[fx.Node, OrderedSet[fx.Node]]] = None, )
